name: Rate Limiting & API Throttle Controls
objectives: Implement per-agent, per-company, and global rate limiting with configurable thresholds
Verify that agents exceeding rate limits receive HTTP 429 with Retry-After header
Implement soft-limit warning system at 80% threshold before hard block
Verify throttle penalty escalation (2x cooldown on repeated violations)
Ensure local_implicit and instance_admin actors bypass rate limits
Implement auto-unblock mechanism after cooldown expiration
Validate regression tests for Milestone 1.3A boundaries remain intact
Output validation scorecard and pass autonomous self-test gate checks
